title: New Feature Request: Integration of Ambrosias BluCon for Libre
symptom: The issue is a feature request to integrate Ambrosia's BluCon NFC to BT reader to read Abbott's Libre data.
fix: The fix is to use the Sept 6th Nightly build of xDrip, which includes the integration and works well.
evidence_quote: With the build of Sept 6th it is working very well since the last 24 Hours. Data transfer and connection/reconnection is full working as far as i see.
